latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor Eye Contact.

- Corrects eye contact in recorded videos using AI, for MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB and returns a 1080p MP4.
- Automatic onboarding with free token generation and session setup; 100 free credits valid for 7 days.
- Supports quick cloud-based processing (1-2 min per video) for content creators, remote workers, and online educators.
- Includes upload, edit, export, credits, and state-check actions with easy file format and error handling.
- Clear workflow guidance, session management, and progress communication; supports batch and iterative editing.
- Requires NEMO_TOKEN and handles API authentication and setup automatically.
